stories.title: Les Townsend
stories.subTitle: CRICKETER OF THE YEAR - 1934
stories.summary: Leslie Fletcher Townsend, one of the best all-round cricketers to appear for Derbyshire, was born at Long Eaton on June 8, 1903, so that his most successful season--that of last summer--came to him rather later in life than it does to the average
